script_text: Brace Leo, the week’s Sun will clash with a square testing love and ambition! Monday: Sun in Cancer trines Leo’s 3rd House, a square to your 8th House ignites love arguments. Friday: Sun moves into Leo’s 7th House, lighting romance, Uranus square to 4th House sparks chaos. Saturday’s Moon void in Virgo, focus on health; Sunday’s Mercury retrograde in your 9th House urges travel delays, Pluto sextile to your 5th House deepens romance. Wednesday powers you as Mars conjuncts Sun, unlocking bold career moves. Monday strains you with Sun square your 8th House, sparking love turbulence. Channel Leo’s Fire by scheduling a confident Wednesday presentation to lock that raise. Follow for daily updates.
